I believe these are the same candles used on submarines to make oxygen: [link]

cites.stt: A candle produces roughly the same amount of energy as a resting human
cites.x: They burn at 600C (1100F) so I don't think you'd want to view the reaction directly; usually they have to be deliberately contained to contain the heat to sustain the reaction.

cites.stt: Seawater electrolysis by adjusting the local reaction environment of a catalyst
cites.x: Yea it produces chlorine. Nuclear subs need to use reverse osmosis first to get around that problem when they want to produce Oxygen from seawater. [link]
